newsitem.title: USA: US inflation under control, no sign of rise-Kantor.
newsitem.headline: US inflation under control, no sign of rise-Kantor.

text.p: U.S. inflation is under control and shows no signs of rising, U.S. Commerce Secretary Mickey Kantor said on Friday.
"There seems to be no sign that inflation is growing," he told Reuters Financial Television. "It's ... well under control."

He welcomed the recent drop in long-term interest rates as "good news" and sang the praises of the economy's performance under his boss, President Clinton. Clinton is up for re-election on November 5.
